status: Added after primary validation; post hoc exploratory extension. Not a prospectively frozen primary contrast or a new unseen validation cohort.
input: analysis/cohort_primary.csv; 248 selected nodes, 130 recorded source groups, 84 malignant/164 benign; no hospital patient linkage verified

comparisons.increment: 10 spectral measurements beyond routine CT plus Node-RADS
Node-RADS plus 10 spectral measurements; not an isolated spectral increment
Reused primary comparison, provided descriptively for subgroup transitions only

outer_allocation: Existing outer_fold in the fixed cohort, generated originally from all 254 source records; never recreated.
preprocessing: SimpleImputer median keep_empty_features=True and StandardScaler, training-fold only.
tuning: GridSearchCV neg_log_loss, 3 grouped inner folds, n_jobs=1, refit=True, error_score=raise.
threshold: Inner OOF probabilities; maximum Youden index with highest threshold for ties; no subgroup selection.
bootstrap: Sample 130 recorded groups with replacement, retain all node multiplicities; same draws across all model metrics, new paired contrasts and category-specific transition summaries. Fixed OOF predictions, thresholds and calibration bin boundaries; no classifier refitting or retuning. Calibration parameter estimation follows the existing evaluation routine.
inference: 95% exploratory percentile CIs, no new confirmatory P values or Holm family changes. Existing primary estimates/comparisons remain unchanged.
transition_interpretation: Agreement with recorded node outcome, not demonstrated treatment benefit or specimen-by-specimen verified malignant status. No independent-node McNemar testing.
routine_definition_limit: Routine CT denotes the four-feature subset from the same source imaging examinations, not an independently acquired conventional CT cohort.
spectral_definition_limit: Increment tests the additional ten-input block; it does not establish causal effects or independent benefits of individual spectral measures.
moderate_probability_examples: Reuse existing SHAP example node/group/fold/probabilities; append actual frozen outer thresholds/predictions. Probability near0.5 is not the decision boundary; no SHAP recalculation.
